name: Bananas
description: The everyday fruit-bowl favorite. Let it ripen in the open, then use the fridge to buy a little extra time.

storage.label: Unripe
storage.advice: Let firm bananas ripen on the counter, checking them each day.

storage.label: Ripe
storage.advice: Refrigerating a ripe banana slows further softening.
storage.caution: The peel may darken in the fridge; check the flesh separately.

buying: Choose yellow bananas for eating soon, or greener fruit for later.
Avoid badly bruised or damaged fruit.
freshness: Soft, ripe flesh works well in baking. Discard rotten fruit or fruit with mold.
leftovers: Mash ripe bananas into pancake batter.

freezing.instructions: Use sound, ripe bananas. Peel and mash, then pack into freezer containers with ½ inch headspace. Seal and freeze.
freezing.quality: The thawed mash suits baking better than fruit salad.

together: Ripening bananas release ethylene. Keep them away from sensitive vegetables, such as leafy greens.
